gloss: blue ballot (a no vote in the Diet)

definitions.explanation: In a recorded vote in Japan's Diet, the blue wooden ballot a member drops in the box to vote against a bill; by extension, a vote against. The ballot for a yes vote is the {白票|はくひょう}.

examples.japanese: {青票|せいひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|とう}じた→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧。
examples.english: He cast a blue ballot (voted no).

examples.japanese: ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧{青票|せいひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|とう}じた→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧。
examples.english: All the opposition members voted against.

examples.japanese: ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{青票|せいひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|とう}じる→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{僅差|きんさ}→僅差：11526_kinsa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Some members of the ruling party also voted against, and the bill passed by a narrow margin.

notes:
Made of {青|せい} (blue) + ⟦{票|ひょう}→票：03582_hyou⟧ (ballot). In a ⟦{記名投票|きめいとうひょう}→記名投票：32679_kimeitouhyou⟧ (recorded vote), each member's name is written on wooden tablets: white for yes, blue for no. The words appear mainly in news of Diet votes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青票|せいひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|とう}じる→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧: to vote against
- ⟦{白票|はくひょう}→白票：28194_hakuhyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{青票|せいひょう}: yes and no ballots

WATCH OUT:
In an ordinary election, ⟦{白票|はくひょう}→白票：28194_hakuhyou⟧ means a blank ballot, a protest vote with no name on it, not a yes vote. Only in the Diet is it the opposite of {青票|せいひょう}.
